notes: Optional native modules not declared in the frozen requirement were excluded from Gold: Slack/Gmail notifications, Supabase memory storage, queue status updates (Mark Queue Processing/Complete), and the ADKAR change-management framework. The optional Google Sheets queue trigger is retained as a second entry because the frozen requirement explicitly declares it as a run condition. Multiple native sheet-write nodes were collapsed into one terminal outcome node, matching the single declared visible outcome.
